quotations.old_english: Þá gehýrdon hí mótian wið Martine lange
quotations.english: they heard a long conversation being carried on with Martin

source_text: mótian; I. add:-- Hí lange mótodon, Hml. S. 34, 214 : 310: 36, 365. Þá gehýrdon hí mótian wið Martine lange (they heard a long conversation being carried on with Martin), and he wæs ána ǽr innan þám húse belocen, 31, 694. [v. N. E. D. moot.] v. ge-mótian.
